title: Grid stacking: multiple components per cell
description: Add sparse stacking overlay to grid zones. Currently cells hold Option<ComponentId> (one component). Add a stacks map for additional occupants below the top, plus stacking_limit on zones. Backward compatible: grid_get/grid_set unchanged (operate on top of stack). New methods: grid_push, grid_pop, grid_stack, grid_stack_size. Zero overhead for non-stacking games (empty hashmap). Required for hex wargames, also useful for Go (multiple stones captured from same position) and any game with unit stacking.
